title: Divide Doughnut
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: An interactive task on a ring divided into a billion numbered parts carrying N sprinkles, N even. The solver may ask how many sprinkles lie in any circular range of parts, and must name a half of the ring, five hundred million consecutive parts, holding exactly N/2 sprinkles, or report that no such half exists. At most thirty plus floor of log2 of root N interactions are permitted.
